name: verify-hook
post_check: ARTIFACT_DIR/verification.md maps story acceptance criteria to scenarios, expected results, and actual test or manual evidence; happy paths and applicable negative and edge cases are covered, and non-applicable cases are explained
Scoped Playwright tests have been written and run successfully; exact commands and results are recorded. Missing tooling or unexecuted or failed required tests block the gate
npm test and npm run build results are recorded and passing; acceptance criteria map to actual evidence
Relevant manual/browser checks are distinguished from not-run checks; any unmet acceptance criterion blocks the gate
Only ARTIFACT_DIR/verification.md and approved, scoped Playwright test files changed in this stage; test changes were reviewed and approved, and application or infrastructure fixes were routed back
Applicable guardrails passed and explicit user approval recorded
